text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Unresolved, insufficient, ambiguous, two-candidate or multiple-orientation results request

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: subdivision. A substantial geometry-only second pattern also requests subdivision.

g.text: 3 Optional “Check passing regions”

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Even a passing parent can test four children. Keep them if a child supports a new

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: phase/zone, a separate pattern, or if the children mix passing and unassigned results.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: A new phase/zone must beat the parent family on that same child by ≥0.08 rank, or the

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: parent family must be absent/below screen.

g.text: 4 Commit a subdivision or retain the parent

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: All four merely lose evidence → retain the parent. Same interpretation without a split

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: trigger → retain the parent. Accepted subdivisions replace the parent and can refine

g.text: recursively.

g.text: Cancelled/incomplete trials leave that parent intact.
